globalThis.readinessPhase = 0;
globalThis.lastRequestComplete = 0;
setTimeout(() => {
  fetch('/readiness-data').then(response => response.text()).then(() => {
    globalThis.readinessPhase = 1;
    setTimeout(() => {
      fetch('/readiness-data').then(response => response.text()).then(() => {
        globalThis.readinessPhase = 2;
        globalThis.lastRequestComplete = performance.now();
        const element = document.createElement('p');
        element.id = 'ready';
        element.textContent = 'Completed';
        document.body.appendChild(element);
      });
    }, 10);
  });
}, 10);
